subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro to unblock Redwood POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro to unblock Redwood POC

Hi Aisha / Daniel —

Great to meet today — thanks for the time and for walking through the Acme Health ingestion and inference goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Summary (1-line): Acme wants a short pilot to validate latency, cost, and data governance before a broader POC.

Key notes from discovery:
- Primary workloads: clinical summarization (avg input 1–2k tokens), embeddings for search, and a real-time triage assistant.
- Data: PHI-handling on a subset of records, want VPC/private deployment for the pilot.
- Success metrics: median latency < 300ms on 512-token seqs, embedding recall lift, and predictable unit cost.

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive alignment (VP / CTO intro) — 30 min — unblock procurement & legal buy-in
2) Technical deep dive (SE + infra) — 60 min — confirm architecture + security constraints
3) Draft SOW and timeline (we’ll share initial SOW)

For the exec intro, would either of these windows work for your team?
- Mon, Apr 4 — 10:00–10:30 PT / 1:00–1:30 ET
- Tue, Apr 5 — 14:00–14:30 PT / 17:00–17:30 ET
(If neither, feel free to pick a time on our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/exec-intro-30)

I’ve attached a one-pager and the initial SOW draft for context. Neha will join the technical call and Vivek (our VP of Sales) will join the exec intro.

Thanks — I’ll wait for a slot and will share a short 10-minute agenda for the exec call.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: Redwood-Product-OnePager.pdf, SOW-draft-Acme-Initial.pdf

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro to unblock Redwood POC

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. I’m happy to do a quick executive intro so we can align on commercial/timeline expectations. Daniel (cc’d) should join for the technical/governance side.

We’re available Tue, Apr 5 at 17:00 ET (your Tue 14:00 PT) — that works best for us.

A couple asks before the call:
- Can you share the high-level security controls and SOC/Security evidence (or point me to where we can review)?
- Also send a 10-min agenda for the exec call so my leadership knows what to expect.

If you want, go ahead and pencil Apr 5 17:00 ET and we’ll confirm once we get the invite.

Best,
Aisha Patel
VP Product | Acme Health
aisha.patel@acmehealth.com
